Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Visitor onboarding and entry verification — NorthBridge exec workshop

Hi Kendra / Visitor Desk team,

We have a small executive workshop on-site at your San Francisco office on Thursday Aug 20 (09:00–15:00). I wanted to confirm the entry process and share a certified visitor list for badging. Please see the attached CSV ("2026-08-17-northbridge-visitor-list.csv") which includes full names, company, mobile, and expected arrival window.

Quick asks:
- Can security pre-approve these visitors for day badges and QR entry?
- Is a government ID check required at the desk (we anticipate three external guests and two Redwood staff listed)?
- Do you require an escort policy for visitors after sign-in? If so, who will be assigned and how long does the escort typically take?

Notes:
- We will bring a printed agenda and emergency contact list.
- We plan to arrive by 08:45 for set-up.

Attaching a short guest briefing for your team: "redwood-onboarding-brief.pdf". If there are any vendor screening forms (NDA, badge waivers), please point me to the correct link and I will make sure attendees complete them ahead of time.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Customer Success Ops
Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Visitor onboarding and entry verification — NorthBridge exec workshop

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the list and the briefing. We can pre-clear the guest list and issue day badges/QRs. A few specifics from our side: 

- ID check: Yes, government-issued photo ID is required at check-in for all external visitors.
- Escort: Visitors may remain unescorted in our designated conference suite (floors 6–8). Outside that area, an escort is required. 
- Background screening: Not required for day visitors unless they request access to restricted labs (not relevant here).

Please confirm:
1) Final headcount by 10:00 on Wednesday Aug 19; we will lock badge provisioning at that time.
2) Will any of your attendees require temporary laptop network access? If so, we need names and device MACs by Wednesday.

I will assign Laura (security coordinator) as your on-site point-of-contact; she will manage the escort schedule if needed.

Best,
Kendra Smith
Director, Facilities & Security
NorthBridge Capital
kendra.smith@northbridge.com
+1 415-222-3344

Ilya and Samir will be arriving a bit earlier and would appreciate a quick security rundown. I'll be on-site for set-up at 08:30.

Thanks — Rachel
